reuse.why: Follows the existing hasSavedTemplates/getFillableCategories pattern, but writes its own #fixed regex instead of using the shared tag parser extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The tag recognition is a second, differently-behaving tag parser (case-insensitive, different delimiters), and the new check is repeated in copyPreviousMonth and getFillableCategories alongside the notes join in both queries, mirroring the existing split.

placement.why: The predicate sits next to hasSavedTemplates in budget/actions.ts and is applied where the existing exclusions are, though tag parsing belongs in shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the two feeding queries, a comment and a release note.

maintainability.why: Two places still assemble the eligibility rule (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth's inline chain), and tag semantics can drift from the rest of the app's tag handling.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts isFixedGroup uses a local regex instead of extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup's regex re-implements tag extraction from shared/tags.ts under a different shape.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is defined once in isFixedGroup and called by both selection paths (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth), although each path still applies it separately.
